questionAudits.finding: B正确：结尾把主观估值明示后按规则可核标准，不任意也非一标签全包。A过广；C仍可推理；D外观看等非关键。

units.approvalScope: Author forward-v2 atomic-bundle review; one unit has the specified grammar-only edit and seven siblings retain exactly the prior authored payload apart from version/revision binding. No independent teacher calibration or new practice supply claimed.

findings: Two complete readings ×five questions. Colour labels, memory performance and sensory discrimination are not equated; the study is explicitly fictional and no colour asset is required.
Early warning detects an event already begun, with location-dependent lead time and distinct detection/issue/receipt events.
Thresholds and demonstrations retain stated error consequences and tested conditions. No real prediction, emergency advice or system certification is made.

unresolvedConcerns: Same-author passage-entailment and all-option review only; no independent teacher/learner calibration.

questionAudits.answerText: They had observed task performance rather than directly established a change in every underlying perceptual process.
questionAudits.finding: C正确：改选择是条件下任务表现，不能直接等同眼睛或全部感知层改变。B有学词；A延迟任务正涉记忆；D未全条件证明同。

questionAudits.answerText: A memory aid could affect one task without proving finer visual discrimination in the other.
questionAudits.finding: A正确：词可组织注意分类记忆，延迟改答不证同时辨更小物理差。B非只有延迟注意；C任务不同；D无必须忘词。

questionAudits.answerText: Instructions and sorting practice were part of the conditions producing the observations.
questionAudits.finding: B正确：标签教学、分类练习和指令都构成情境，需后比辨记忆/感度解释。A不保证无影响；C、D过证据。

questionAudits.answerText: It does not by itself define a complete limit on the speaker’s possible colour experience.
questionAudits.finding: D正确：词汇是可用语言工具，不是所有体验边界，不等看不见。A错误；B实践区别可异；C可学新词。

questionAudits.answerText: Language can matter in a task without its observed effect automatically identifying one universal mechanism of seeing.
questionAudits.finding: C正确：末段两极都不取，连接具体任务及证据，分注意记忆命名感度。B、A绝对；D不作个人到全体规则。

questionAudits.answerText: It can detect an event already begun and seek to precede later local effects.
questionAudits.finding: D正确：地震已起后探测，可能赶在远处后续影响前，不是事件未发生预知。A反定义；C不必源近；B延迟关键。

questionAudits.answerText: Strong motion could arrive before detection and communication were completed.
questionAudits.finding: B正确：近地强振可先于流程完成，距离与延迟使时窗不同。A因果倒置；C非无振；D不一时刻保证。

questionAudits.answerText: Earlier decisions can involve less evidence, while waiting can consume available time.
questionAudits.finding: A正确：早信息少可能误报，等更证据则时窗少，需按用途权衡。B反；C无保证；D错误后果仍需选择。

questionAudits.answerText: A message being issued is not the same event as it reaching a particular recipient.
questionAudits.finding: C正确：检测、发、收不同，个别成功时长不可通化；分记通信阶段。A没说字句站站变；B其他时点可测；D延迟重要。

questionAudits.answerText: As evidence under tested conditions, alongside failures and limits relevant to the intended service.
questionAudits.finding: A正确：限定情境网络及用途，成功与漏延误警并存评估。B外推；C已开始；D记录失败仍必要。
